question:
I have macro that will check the db name. I want to call this macro in my sql script and perform union if there is a result from my macro . How can I do this?

select abc from books

if {{get_db_name()}} == TRUE UNION

select abc from book_2;
title: How to call a macro using if condition in DBT?
answer:
You'll want your code to look a little like this:

select abc from books

{% if get_db_name() == True %}
  UNION

  select abc from book_2
{% endif %}

That said, do you know about the target variable? It allows you to key off target name, target database etc which might be a better option of doing what you want.
